^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.description:
Where the Icon comes from: <source> [name] [modifiers]

- google <name>: the Material Symbols name, outlined, weight 500, 20px
  - fill: uses the filled variant
  - w100 to w700: uses that weight instead of 500
  - s20, s24, s40, s48: uses that optical size instead of 20px
- fontAwesome: taken from Font Awesome
- other: taken from another icon set
- custom: drawn for this project
